[DE|Local] rbb24 Der Tag in Berlin und Brandenburg (Berlin) (Fri 19:17): Jugendgewalt | Raffineriestrategie | Wahlrecht
item.description:
Originally published Fri 23 Oct 2026 19:17 IDT.
Jugendliche, die andere Jugendliche bedrohen, ausrauben, krankenhausreif schlagen: In Potsdam sitzen sechs Tatverdächtige deswegen inzwischen in Untersuchungshaft. Und immer lauter wird die Kritik, die Behörden hätten beim Thema Jugendgewalt zu lange weggeschaut. Weitere Themen: Reaktionen aus Schwedt auf die Raffineriestrategie der Bundeswirtschaftsministerin. Rot-Grün-Rot in Berlin will Wählen ohne Pass ermöglichen. Und: Bundeskanzler zu Besuch beim Frankfurter Leibniz-Institut für innovative Mikroelektronik.   "DER TAG in Berlin und Brandenburg" – kompakt und informativ mit dem Neuesten aus Ihrer Region. Abonnieren und hören können Sie den Podcast in ARD Sounds. "DER TAG" gibt es auch im Vorabendprogramm im rbb-Fernsehen, immer montags bis freitags 18 Uhr.

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Fri 17:31): Sudan's hospitals deliberately targeted by RSF fighters
item.description:
Originally published Fri 23 Oct 2026 17:31 IDT.

A BBC investigation has found evidence that Sudanese paramilitary fighters systematically destroyed El-Fasher's healthcare system during their long siege and subsequent takeover of the city in Darfur a year ago. UN human rights chief Volker Türk called the findings "deeply disturbing", saying multiple attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) on civilian infrastructure, including health facilities, were serious violations of international humanitarian law and may amount to war crimes. Also: the Israeli military says two soldiers were killed in an attack by Palestinian gunmen in the occupied West Bank. The two suspected attackers were shot dead by the IDF. Ukrainian defence officials say there are still restrictions on their use of the Starshield satellite network, despite President Trump saying it was operating normally. And, the brave little octopus who escapes death after venturing from her normal underwater habitat.
